<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:acme="https://example.com/schema/acme/1.0" id="Definitions_Order" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn" acme:owner="Team Šumi & Co">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Order" name="Naročilo – Bestellung" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Naročilo prejeto">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCheckStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Preveri zalogo (Lager prüfen)" acme:sla="PT2H">
      <bpmn:documentation>Checks <stock> & reserves items; see "Lagerbestand" policy.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <acme:retryPolicy retries="3" backoff="PT5S">
          <acme:note>Façade call – keep idempotent</acme:note>
        </acme:retryPolicy>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCheckStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InStock" name="Na zalogi? 在库?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipOrder" name="Odpošlji naročilo 📦">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToShipped</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CancelOrder" name="Prekliči "naročilo" & obvesti">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCancelled</bpmn:outgoing>
